fix(infra): preserve ordinary cleanup boundaries after simplification
fix(infra): check snapshot identity before native retirement
test(infra): preserve bootstrap exports in caller mocks
chore(infra): clean lifecycle callbacks and retire mock exceptions
fix(infra): join snapshot cancellation and preserve failure diagnostics
refactor(infra): retire unused worker ancestry state
refactor(infra): remove retired ancestry inventory and mock seams
fix(infra): invalidate late-registered write receipt scopes
fix(infra): preserve committed cache invalidation after simplification
fix(infra): admit writable SQLite handles before transactions
test(infra): keep native settlement coverage without writer fences
